verdict.rationale: The docs show automations can be created: a walked-through path is saved as a skill and rerun on a schedule, and routines can be triggered by events. Nothing in the pack documents version history, diff or review of automation changes, or rolling a skill or routine back to an earlier state. Duplicating a Bot, sharing templates and Auto Review of tool calls are adjacent features, not versioning or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
